answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs thus has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the meadow hash is checked against the horizon checkpoint at intake, the vertex audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 5 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
